title: Require Service Database Import Funnel
forbids: a direct database-source import from a standalone service module, handler, root anchor, model, or module middleware
why: Database source realizes service-owned stores. Only database internals and named service-root middleware need that source; modules consume the projected capabilities through inherited oRPC context.
remediate: Move the database import to a named service-root middleware file, project a narrow store capability into context, and consume that capability from the module handler. Keep external database acquisition in its resource/provider owner.
message: Database source may flow only into service-root middleware or other database-owned source.
